name: button
description: The product's buttons: three grades and no fourth (solid, keyline, quiet), plus the citation pair (cite, wrong), which always appear together. A link or a button element; both render identically. v4 C2 adds Ask's round pills (form pill) and the message tools (form icon with a tool).

grade.description: solid: the one committing action of a view. keyline: a secondary action. quiet: a dotted-underlined word, for the least weight. cite: the source under something the journal wrote, 'March 2026', '4 entries' (was .cite, which is not .btn: the base button box does not apply to it). Its rating is the thumbs component (wrong, 'That's not right', retired in v4 round 10).

form.description: text: a word. icon: a --tap square holding a glyph, the entry tools' edit and delete (was .entry-icon). toggle: the show/hide control inside a password field (was .password-toggle). note: the quiet 'Forgot your password?' line under a field, aligned to its start (was .forgot). transport: every button of the compact recorder (was .compact-recorder .btn): its own gap and 20px glyph, and a grey disabled state. switch: an on/off setting written as a word with a track and knob after it (Timeline search's "By meaning"); a button element with role="switch" and aria-checked, never a link; the grade does not apply (no box, no fill, no border of its own). pill (v4 C2, Ask's head and drawers): a round button, an optional icon then the word, and an optional count badge; history, bookmarks, new, today, close. The grade does not apply (no data-grade is written). Below the container's 1200 a pill with an icon shows only its icon (the word stays for screen readers): round, --tap square, or the icon and the count. A pill without an icon keeps its word at every width. The icon form also carries Ask's message tools (option tool).

disabled.description: The one disabled control in the product, the microphone exception: Start in the compact recorder's transport while the microphone is blocked or missing. A button element only; everywhere else an unavailable action is not shown.

checked.description: The switch form only: on (aria-checked="true"). Its parent flips it on press; the button has no script.

tool.description: The icon form only, v4 C2: one of a message's tools (data-tool), a button element; down also writes aria-expanded="false" (the disclosure of its form, which its parent opens), the glyph in the icon slot (system/content/icons.mjs BOOKMARK, COPY, THUMB_UP, THUMB_DOWN). A --tap square, --rule-2 at rest; 36px with a fine pointer. Hover: --rule on an 8% --rule ground; up: a 70% mix of --rate-up with --rule on a 13% --rate-up ground; down: the same in --rate-down at 11%. Pressed (aria-pressed="true"): bookmark --rule, up --rate-up, down --rate-down, the glyph filled. down while its form is open (aria-expanded="true") keeps its hover look. A parent hides the tools at rest through --aj-c-button-rest; a pressed or expanded tool, or one with keyboard focus, is always shown. copy: its parent writes data-copied="<the word>" on it for a moment, and the tool shows the word in a small tag above it (--ink ground, --paper words, 11px labels); the button has no script.

pressed.description: The tool option bookmark, up or down: set (aria-pressed="true"). These three always write aria-pressed ("false" when not set); copy never does.

count.description: The pill form only: a count badge after the word (the day's bookmarks). 0 draws the empty badge (data-zero): no fill, --rule-2, a 40% --rule ring.

expanded.description: The pill form only: the pill opens a drawer; written as aria-expanded ("true" or "false") when given, omitted otherwise. true draws it pressed: --rule ground, --paper words, the count inverted.

label.description: Final copy. For the icon and toggle forms it is the accessible name (aria-label) and the glyph carries no text. For the switch form it is the visible word ("By meaning") and the accessible name. The pill form: the visible word and the accessible name (visually hidden below 1200 when the pill has an icon). The tool option: the accessible name (Bookmark, Copy, Helpful, Not helpful).

href.description: Renders an a element when given, a button element otherwise.

icon.description: The glyph of the icon and toggle forms (the entry tools' pencil and bin, the password eye and its slash). The pill form's optional glyph before the word (HISTORY, BOOKMARK_SOLID, PLUS); the tools' glyphs.

exposes.--aj-c-button-switch-h: The switch form's height, default --tap: the parent sets it to stretch the switch to its own line (the Timeline search pill sets it while it morphs).
exposes.--aj-c-button-rest: The tool option: the tool's opacity at rest, default 1. A message sets it to 0 with a fine pointer and back to 1 on its hover or focus, so its tools fade in (180ms on --gc); a pressed, expanded or focused tool ignores it.

states.hover: yes: solid fills --block; keyline's border darkens to --rule; quiet and cite turn --block; pill: --rule ground, --paper words, the count inverted (--paper ground, --rule figure); tool: as the tool option says
states.active: yes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
states.disabled: yes: only in the compact recorder's transport, --grid ground and grey, not-allowed cursor
states.selected: yes: the toggle form with aria-pressed="true" (the password is shown); the switch form with aria-checked="true" (the track filled --rule, the knob --paper, moved to the end); the pill with expanded true (its drawer is open): as hover; a tool with pressed true: filled in its colour
states.loading: n/a: a button never shows its own progress
states.error: n/a: errors are written beside the field, not on the button

a11y.role: button, or link when it navigates
a11y.keyboard: Tab to it, Enter (and Space on a button element) to press; Space or Enter flips a switch
a11y.labels: the icon and toggle forms need aria-label; the toggle carries aria-pressed; the switch carries role="switch" and aria-checked

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css E2 (.btn and its grades, .cite, .wrong) with the entry-tools icon, the password toggle and the forgot line as forms.
The disabled option renders the disabled attribute (the microphone exception), so the recorder can draw its blocked Start.
The toggle draws its own eye (with its slash part) when given no icon: the password field's show/hide (13-login).

The switch form (v4 C1, the Timeline search's By meaning): a word, then a 30x18 track with a 12px knob (no script: the parent flips it); checked fills the track and moves the knob 12px, 160ms on --gc; reduced motion drops the travel.

v4 C2: the pill form (Ask's head and drawer pills: icon, word, count badge, icon-only below 1200, expanded) and the tool option of the icon form (Ask's message tools: bookmark, copy, up, down; their hover and pressed colours, the rest opacity a message sets, the copied tag).
v4 round 10: grade wrong (That's not right) retired; what the journal wrote is rated with the thumbs component, as in Ask.
